title: Imperial Cholas: more rulers, conquests, Vengi links

boxes.title: Rulers: added detail
head: Ruler
Added point
rows: Largest South Indian state; first Chola **naval army**

boxes.title: Srivijaya expedition
items: Cause: Srivijaya blocked traders on **China** route; Chola-Sailendra ties soured
Rajaraja I had sent an earlier expedition against the Sailendras
Dravidian art to SE Asia: **Angkor Wat**, **Borobudur**

boxes.title: Vengi viceroys & Kulottunga I
items: **Saktivarman I**: Vimaladitya's elder brother; ruled after **Jatachoda Bhima** ousted
**Rajaraja III (Mummadi Chola)**: Vishnuvardhana, Sarvalokashraya; commander **Gonka I**; installed **Anantavarman Chodaganga**
**Vira Chola**: viceroy twice; crowned at Jagannathapuram
Rajaraja Chola Ganga: up to **Mahendragiri**; **Tekkali** inscription
Kulottunga I born **Rajendra Chalukya**; ousted by **Vijayaditya VII** (**1070**); merged Vengi **1075** (G2 **2011**: first Chalukya-Chola)

boxes.title: More exam points
items: Most voluminous inscriptions in South India
Grand Chola Museum: **125-ft** Rajaraja statue; **Rs 56.41 crore**
**Poompuhar**: third phase of underwater exploration (**8 Sep 2026**)
